description: A strip of half width 1,500 mm along z = 4,000 inside a 20 m by 10 m rectangle whose top edge has a notch reaching down to (10,000, 5,000). Both vertices of the polyline lie inside the polygon and the polyline crosses no edge, but the notch's tip lies 1,000 mm from the polyline, so the strip's width enters the notch: the strip does not lie inside the polygon (PRD v4 5.4.18 (10)).
name: notch
